actions.name: get_service_status
actions.description: Get the current operational status of Elsevier's ClinicalKey COUNTER 5.1 service.

inputSchema.description: Input for checking the ClinicalKey COUNTER service status.

status.description: The raw COUNTER 5.1 JSON object returned by Elsevier.

outputSchema.description: The ClinicalKey COUNTER service status response.

actions.name: get_usage_report
actions.description: Retrieve one ClinicalKey COUNTER 5.1 usage report for an inclusive date range with optional standard filters and attributes.

reportId.description: The report identifier returned by list_reports, such as PR, PR_P1, TR_B1, or TR_J1.

beginDate.description: The inclusive first usage date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The inclusive last usage date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

items.description: One official COUNTER filter value, without the pipe separator used on the wire.

dataTypes.description: The official COUNTER Data_Type values to include, such as Book, Journal, or Reference_Work.

items.description: One official COUNTER filter value, without the pipe separator used on the wire.

accessTypes.description: The official COUNTER Access_Type values to include, such as Controlled, Open, or Free_To_Read.

items.description: One official COUNTER filter value, without the pipe separator used on the wire.

accessMethods.description: The official COUNTER Access_Method values to include, such as Regular or TDM.

items.description: One official COUNTER filter value, without the pipe separator used on the wire.

metricTypes.description: The official COUNTER Metric_Type values to include, such as Total_Item_Requests or Unique_Item_Requests.

items.description: One official COUNTER filter value, without the pipe separator used on the wire.

yearsOfPublication.description: The publication years or ranges to include, such as 2024, 2020-2024, 0001, or 9999.

database.description: The database name to include when the selected report supports the Database filter.

itemId.description: The item identifier to include when the selected title report supports the Item_ID filter.

items.description: One official COUNTER filter value, without the pipe separator used on the wire.

attributesToShow.description: The additional official COUNTER columns or elements to include in the report.

inputSchema.description: Input for retrieving one ClinicalKey COUNTER 5.1 usage report.

report.description: The raw COUNTER 5.1 JSON object returned by Elsevier.

outputSchema.description: The requested ClinicalKey COUNTER usage report.

actions.name: list_members
actions.description: List the consortium members or sites associated with the connected ClinicalKey customer account.

inputSchema.description: Input for listing ClinicalKey consortium members or sites.

items.description: The raw COUNTER 5.1 JSON object returned by Elsevier.

members.description: The member account records, including customer and requestor identifiers returned by Elsevier.

outputSchema.description: The ClinicalKey consortium members or sites.

actions.name: list_reports
actions.description: List the COUNTER 5.1 usage reports currently available to the connected ClinicalKey customer account.

inputSchema.description: Input for listing available ClinicalKey COUNTER reports.

items.description: The raw COUNTER 5.1 JSON object returned by Elsevier.

reports.description: The account-specific report definitions returned by Elsevier.
